title: cyclosorus abruptus
intro: Cyclosorus abruptus, commonly known as the interrupted chain fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant is traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, which may help in treating conditions like fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Cyclosorus abruptus include its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity, making it a potential treatment for various diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are often used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions.
